# Visit Grand Junction

> > Official tourism guide for Grand Junction, Colorado, featuring outdoor adventures at Colorado National Monument, Grand Mesa trails, and the Colorado River valley.

Visit Grand Junction is the destination marketing organization for Grand Junction, Colorado, showcasing year-round outdoor recreation, dining experiences, and tourism information for visitors to Colorado's wine country and adventure hub on the western slope.

## Key Topics

- Colorado National Monument
- Grand Mesa
- Colorado River
- Rim Rock Drive
- Palisade Plunge
- Mountain biking
- Dog-friendly trails
- Hiking adventures
- Downtown Grand Junction
- Farm-to-table dining
- Bin 707 Foodbar
- Outdoor activities
- Devil's Kitchen
- Gunnison River
- Colorado Plateau

## Outdoor Adventures & Activities

- [Things to Do in Colorado National monument | Visit Grand Junction](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/6-ways-to-experience-colorado-national-monument): Guide to Colorado National Monument with Rim Rock Drive & outdoor activities
- [Colorado Adventure Tours in Grand Junction, CO](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/adventure-vacations-in-colorado): Year-round adventure tours on Colorado Plateau with hiking & biking options
- [Palisade Plunge Mountain Bike Trail | Visit Grand Junction](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/take-the-plunge): Expert 32-mile Palisade Plunge downhill trail on Grand Mesa
- [Pet Friendly Weekend Activities in Grand Junction](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/a-pet-friendly-weekend-getaway-in-grand-junction): Dog-friendly weekend guide with hiking, hotels & outdoor activities

## Trip Planning & Itineraries

- [Spring Break Itinerary in Grand Junction, CO](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/spring-break-itinerary-in-grand-junction-co): Kid-friendly spring break itinerary featuring Colorado National Monument
- [A Guide to Eloping in Grand Junction Colorado](https://www.visitgrandjunction.com/blog/post/planning-your-colorado-elopement): Elopement planning guide with Colorado National Monument & Grand Mesa venues
